fields.System.Title: INV-102 — Query stock by product
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a supervisor, I want to see every location holding a product, so that I can find
stock when a pick face is empty.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a product with stock in several locations, when I query it, then I get each
  • location with its quantities and status.
  • - Given the result, then it can be filtered by warehouse, by zone, and by status.
  • - Given a product with no stock, then I get an empty result.
  • - Given the result, then virtual locations are identified as such, so in-transit and
  • written-off stock are not mistaken for sellable stock.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory |
| Tables | stock_balance |
| Risks | Virtual location stock counted as available ([doc 05 WF 12](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
